name: EXM_MATCHING_HISTORY
description: This table contains the expense status, starting from creation to automatic sweep.

columns.name: MATCHING_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of events recorded in the table.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person identifier of the individual on the corporate card.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of event, whether creation, matching, or submission.

columns.name: EVENT_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Source of the event, whether bot creation, bot update, resolution of potential matches, during the hourly matching process, after manual expense submission, or during the automatic submission process.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Code to identify if the expense being matched is sourced from a vendor expense or from an existing expense.

columns.name: EVENT_START_TIME
columns.description: The time when the event started.

columns.name: MATCHED_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Name of rule the expense was matched against, whether an auth transaction number, a receipt, an amount, or a merchant.

columns.name: MATCHING_OUTCOME
columns.description: Results generated from matching digital expenses to card or authorization expenses while detecting duplicates.

columns.name: RECEIPT_AMOUNT_MATCH_RULE
columns.description: Rule name using which the score is generated for Receipt Amount.

columns.name: RECEIPT_DATE_MATCH_RULE
columns.description: Rule name using which the score is generated for Receipt Date.

columns.name: RECEIPT_CURRENCY_MATCH_RULE
columns.description: Rule name using which the score is generated for Receipt Currency.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TYPE_MATCH_RULE
columns.description: Rule name using which the score is generated for Expense Type.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TYPE_CAT_MATCH_RULE
columns.description: Rule name using which the score is generated for Expense Type Category.

columns.name: MERCHANT_NAME_MATCH_RULE
columns.description: Rule name using which the score is generated for Merchant Name.

columns.name: RECEIPT_AMOUNT_MATCH_SCORE
columns.description: Score of an uploaded digital assistant expense item's receipt amount that matches a corporate card transaction's transaction amount.

columns.name: RECEIPT_DATE_MATCH_SCORE
columns.description: Score of an uploaded digital assistant expense item's receipt date that matches a corporate card transaction's transaction date.

columns.name: RECEIPT_CURRENCY_MATCH_SCORE
columns.description: Score of an uploaded digital assistant expense item's receipt currency that matches a corporate card transaction's transaction currency.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TYPE_MATCH_SCORE
columns.description: Score of an uploaded digital assistant expense item's expense type that matches a corporate card transaction's expense type.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TYPE_CAT_MATCH_SCORE
columns.description: Score of an uploaded digital assistant expense item's expense type category that matches a corporate card transaction's expense type category.

columns.name: MERCHANT_NAME_MATCH_SCORE
columns.description: Score of an uploaded digital assistant expense item's merchant name that matches a corporate card transaction's merchant name.

columns.name: LOCATION_MATCH_SCORE
columns.description: Score generated by matching the location during duplicate expense detection.

columns.name: DISTANCE_MATCH_SCORE
columns.description: Score generated by matching the distance during duplicate expense detection.

columns.name: DISTANCE_UNIT_MATCH_SCORE
columns.description: Score generated by matching the distance unit during duplicate expense detection.

columns.name: RECEIPT_TIME_MATCH_SCORE
columns.description: Score generated by matching the receipt time during duplicate expense detection.

columns.name: END_DATE_MATCH_SCORE
columns.description: Score generated by matching the end date during duplicate expense detection.

columns.name: APPROVAL_CODE_MATCH_SCORE
columns.description: Score generated by matching the approval status code during duplicate detection.

columns.name: TOTAL_MATCH_SCORE
columns.description: Total score of an uploaded digital assistant expense item that matches a corporate card transaction.

columns.name: MERGED_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates whether an expense item created from a digital assistant is already merged with an expense item created from a corporate card transaction.

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifies the group of duplicate expenses.

columns.name: ANCHOR_EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the anchor expense within a group of duplicate expenses.

columns.name: ANCHOR_RANK
columns.description: Indicates the priority of anchors within a group of duplicate expenses.

columns.name: DA_EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense item that was created from the digital assistant.

columns.name: DA_AUTH_TRXN_NUMBER
columns.description: Credit card transaction authorization code captured by the digital assistant. The value is obtained from the credit card charge.

columns.name: DA_RECEIPT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Digital Assistant receipt amount in the receipt currency.

columns.name: DA_RECEIPT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Receipt currency of a digital assistant expense item.

columns.name: DA_MERCHANT_NAME
columns.description: Merchant where the expense was incurred, which was captured by the digital assistant.

columns.name: DA_START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the expense occurred or the first day of an expense that spans multiple days.

columns.name: DA_END_DATE
columns.description: Last day of the Digital Assistant expense, if it spans multiple days.

columns.name: DA_APPROVAL_CODE
columns.description: Approval code for the Digital Assistant expense.

columns.name: DA_EXPENSE_TYPE_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Group of expense types and additional data fields for similar expenses. For example, the airfare group to include information such as class of fare, merchant, ticket number, and so on.

columns.name: DA_CREATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Method of expense item creation, such as mobile iOS device or mobile Android device.

columns.name: DA_REPORT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of an expense report type related to a digital assistant expense.

columns.name: DA_EXPENSE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of an expense type related to a digital assistant expense.

columns.name: DA_TYPE_KEYWORDS
columns.description: The keywords returned by IDR that are used to narrow down the expense type.

columns.name: CC_EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense item created from a corporate card transaction.

columns.name: CC_AUTH_TRXN_NUMBER
columns.description: Authorization transaction number provided by the corporate card issuer.

columns.name: CC_RECEIPT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Credit card expense amount of the receipt in the receipt currency.

columns.name: CC_RECEIPT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Receipt currency of a credit card expense item.

columns.name: CC_MERCHANT_NAME
columns.description: Merchant where the expense was incurred.

columns.name: CC_START_DATE
columns.description: Date when the Corporate Card expense occurred or the first day of an expense that spans multiple days.

columns.name: CC_END_DATE
columns.description: Last day of the Corporate Card expense, if it spans multiple days.

columns.name: CC_TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date when the credit card transaction occurred.

columns.name: CC_APPROVAL_CODE
columns.description: Approval code for the Corporate Card expense.

columns.name: CC_EXPENSE_TYPE_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Classification of an expense item such as business or personal.

columns.name: CC_EXPENSE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of expense type in a credit card expense.

columns.name: CC_CREATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Method of expense item creation, such as mobile iOS device or mobile Android device.

columns.name: CC_AIR_DEPARTURE_DATE
columns.description: Departure date for the first leg of a multiple leg trip.

columns.name: CC_HOTEL_DEPART_DATE
columns.description: Departure date from a hotel for a credit card expense.

columns.name: CC_HOTEL_ARRIVAL_DATE
columns.description: Check-in date at hotel or scheduled arrival date in case of a no show.

columns.name: CC_CAR_RETURN_DATE
columns.description: Credit card expense date in which the car was returned.

columns.name: CC_CAR_RENTAL_DATE
columns.description: Credit card expense date in which the car was first rented.

columns.name: CC_REPORT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of an expense report for credit card expenses.
